name: The Stillness
source:
"All of humanity's problems stem from man's inability to sit quietly in a room alone." - Blaise Pascal

What do you do when you can't fight off your demons? You run. Run like hell, and pray to all of the gods that you never trip.

All of that running has brought you to your third school in as many months.  It was the only school left in the Mainland that would accept you even with a record like yours.  You're all too aware that you're on your last chance, and that last chance is St. Vera's. An inclusion school that will accept anyone regardless of their race, background or circumstances. 

It becomes evident almost immediately that everyone there ended up at a place like this for a reason. In a past that you have been staunchly against confronting, you faced down far more terrifying things, but somehow you get the feeling that this school is going to be the end of you. 

Beggars can't be choosers though, and frankly, your legs are starting to get tired.

[From [url=https://thestillness.itch.io/the-stillness]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“人类所有的问题都源于人类无法独自安静地坐在房间里。” ——布莱斯·帕斯卡

当你无法战胜心中的恶魔时，你会做什么？你跑吧。拼命奔跑，向所有的神祈祷你永远不会绊倒。

所有这些跑步已经把你带到了几个月内的第三所学校。即使你有这样的成绩，那也是内地唯一一所愿意录取你的学校。你们都非常清楚，你们正面临着最后的机会，而最后的机会就是圣维拉。一所包容性学校将接受任何人，无论其种族、背景或情况如何。

几乎立刻就可以看出，那里的每个人最终来到这样的地方都是有原因的。在过去，你一直坚决反对面对，你面对过更可怕的事情，但不知怎的，你有一种感觉，这所学校将是你的终结。

不过，乞丐不能挑剔，坦白说，你的腿已经开始累了。

[来自[url=https://thestillness.itch.io/the-stillness]Itch.io[/url]]
